---
title: "📷 Light Preserver Archive"
subtitle: "DIGITAL & ANALOG PHOTOGRAPH GALLERY"
---


```{=html}
<style>
  .gallery-section {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", Arial, sans-serif;
    color: #1d1d1f;
    margin: 3rem 0;
  }
  
  /* 필터 레이아웃 */
  .filter-container { margin-bottom: 2rem; font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.8; }
  .filter-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; }
  .filter-label { width: 80px; font-weight: 600; color: #86868b; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; }
  .filter-options { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 1rem; }
  .filter-btn { background: none; border: none; padding: 0; color: #86868b; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.2s; }
  .filter-btn:hover, .filter-btn.active { color: #1d1d1f; font-weight: 500; }

  /* 하마다 히데아키 스타일 초고밀도 그리드 */
  .gallery-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr));
    gap: 4px;
  }
  
  .gallery-item {
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;
    overflow: hidden;
    background-color: #f5f5f7;
  }
  .gallery-item.hidden { display: none; }
  .gallery-item img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.4s ease; }
  
  /* 애플 스타일 오버레이 */
  .item-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%;
    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65);
    color: #fff;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    padding: 12px;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  }
  .gallery-item:hover .item-overlay { opacity: 1; }
  .gallery-item:hover img { transform: scale(1.04); }
  
  .item-title { font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 4px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
  .item-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #d2d2d7; line-height: 1.3; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; }

  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .gallery-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(120px, 1fr)); gap: 2px; }
    .item-overlay { padding: 8px; }
    .item-title { font-size: 0.8rem; }
    .item-desc { display: none; }
  }
</style>

<div class="gallery-section">
  <div class="filter-container">
    <div class="filter-row" data-filter-group="period">
      <div class="filter-label">Period</div>
      <div class="filter-options">
        <button class="filter-btn active" data-filter="all">All</button>
        <button class="filter-btn" data-filter="~2010">~2010</button>
        <button class="filter-btn" data-filter="2011~2020">2011~2020</button>
        <button class="filter-btn" data-filter="2021~2030">2021~2030</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-row" data-filter-group="theme"><div class="filter-label">Theme</div><div class="filter-options"><button class="filter-btn active" data-filter="all">All</button><button class="filter-btn" data-filter="City">City</button><button class="filter-btn" data-filter="Nature">Nature</button><button class="filter-btn" data-filter="Portrait">Portrait</button><button class="filter-btn" data-filter="Food">Food</button></div></div>
    <div class="filter-row" data-filter-group="camera"><div class="filter-label">Camera</div><div class="filter-options"><button class="filter-btn active" data-filter="all">All</button><button class="filter-btn" data-filter="Sony">Sony</button><button class="filter-btn" data-filter="Nikon">Nikon</button><button class="filter-btn" data-filter="Leica">Leica</button><button class="filter-btn" data-filter="Film">Film</button></div></div>
  </div>

  <div class="gallery-grid" id="lightGallery"></div>
</div>

<div style="clear: both; margin-bottom: 3rem;"></div>

<script>
  (function() {
    const filters = { period: 'all', theme: 'all', camera: 'all' };
    const grid = document.getElementById('lightGallery');

    // [로직 1] YYYY.MM 포맷을 상단 필터 카테고리로 변환하는 함수
    function parsePeriodToCategory(dateStr) {
      if (!dateStr) return 'unknown';
      const year = parseInt(dateStr.split('.')[0], 10);
      if (isNaN(year)) return 'unknown';

      if (year <= 2010) return '~2010';
      if (year >= 2011 && year <= 2020) return '2011~2020';
      if (year >= 2021 && year <= 2030) return '2021~2030';
      return 'unknown';
    }

    // JSON 데이터 호출
    fetch('gallery.json')
      .then(res => {
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error("Data load failed");
        return res.json();
      })
      .then(data => {
        data.forEach(item => {
          // [로직 2] 입력된 원본 날짜를 카테고리로 변환하여 data-computed-period 속성에 주입
          const computedCategory = parsePeriodToCategory(item.period);

          const el = document.createElement('div');
          el.className = 'gallery-item';
          el.setAttribute('data-computed-period', computedCategory);
          el.setAttribute('data-theme', item.theme);
          el.setAttribute('data-camera', item.camera);

          // 하마다 히데아키 스타일을 위한 메타데이터 마크업 생성
          el.innerHTML = `
            <img src="${item.image}" alt="${item.title}" loading="lazy">
            <div class="item-overlay">
              <div class="item-title">${item.title} (${item.period})</div>
              <div class="item-desc">${item.desc}</div>
            </div>
          `;
          grid.appendChild(el);
        });

        initFilters();
      })
      .catch(err => {
        grid.innerHTML = `<p style="color:#86868b; text-align:center; padding: 2rem 0;">데이터 파이프라인 연결 오류</p>`;
      });

    function initFilters() {
      const filterRows = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-row');
      const items = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-item');

      filterRows.forEach(row => {
        const group = row.getAttribute('data-filter-group');
        const buttons = row.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');

          buttons.forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              buttons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
              btn.classList.add('active');
              filters[group] = btn.getAttribute('data-filter');
              
              items.forEach(item => {
                // 변환된 계산값(data-computed-period)을 기준으로 필터 매칭 실행
                const mPeriod = (filters.period === 'all' || filters.period === item.getAttribute('data-computed-period'));
                const mTheme = (filters.theme === 'all' || filters.theme === item.getAttribute('data-theme'));
                const mCamera = (filters.camera === 'all' || filters.camera === item.getAttribute('data-camera'));

                if (mPeriod && mTheme && mCamera) {
                  item.classList.remove('hidden');
                } else {
                  item.classList.add('hidden');
                }
              });
            });
          });
        });
      }
    })();
</script>
```
